items.title: B2B Fuzz Final — one command from WASM guard to CI gate
items.summary: Ship a security guard, pick Scan · Audit · Deep, miners fuzz it on the pool, get an HTML report plus a pass/fail gate your pipeline can enforce. hackme-fuzzing wizard — no browser admin on the public site.
items.impact: Protocol teams get a productized audit path: local node escrow (20/80 HMC), distributed useful-PoW workers, customer report token, GET /gate for CI. Coordinator now re-verifies WASM on found nonces — fabricated worker gate passes cannot drain bounty. Ops: fuzz_b2b_final_gate.sh → VERDICT.md.
